install.title: Install OISP Notifications
install.intro: Install the web app on your home screen to open it like an app and receive push notifications. No App Store or Google Play needed.
install.installed: You're using the installed app. Go to Account to turn on notifications if you haven't yet.
install.ios2: Tap the Share button (square with an up arrow) in the bottom bar.
install.ios3: Scroll down, choose "Add to Home Screen", then tap "Add".
install.ios4: Open the new "OISP" icon on your home screen, sign in and turn on notifications.
install.iosOld: Your device runs iOS older than 16.4, so it can't receive push notifications. You can still install the app and read notifications; update iOS to get push.
install.android2: Tap ⋮ in the top-right corner → "Add to Home screen" or "Install app".
install.android3: Open the app, sign in and tap "Turn on notifications". On Android you also get notifications in Chrome without installing.
install.desktop1: Click the install icon at the end of the address bar, or menu → "Install OISP Notifications".
install.desktop2: Installing is optional: sign in and click "Turn on notifications" to get notifications while the browser is open.
